keep_playing_why: Within seconds I knew what to do, I got small wins every few seconds (pops, combos, crumbs), and each level ended with stars and a new kitchen with a new trick like burners and the Jar boss. In A I spent much of my time walking to a button and tapping it, and I got stuck on the ledges and the boss fight where I could not tell what was dangerous.
better_made_why: B was clear on a phone at every step: readable UI, juicy kill feedback, combo text, music that changed for the boss and a victory jingle, and no bugs I could see. A has beautiful art and atmosphere, but I hit camera blockage behind pillars, falls that reset my progress, assist walks that froze, and boss warnings I could not read.
furthest_A: Woke all 3 windmills (Sails, Pipes, Ladders), crossed the sky bridge into the Hollow, carved the two channels, then beat the bell guardian (3/3 vanes) and reached 'Ride the grilles back up to the bells' (final ascent) at about 450 s.
furthest_B: Cleared The Cutting Board (3 stars, 12,500) and The Stovetop including the boss fight with THE JAR (3 stars, 44,620, 448 olives popped, best combo x86), then reached wave 2 of 10 on level 3, The Sink, at about 541 s.
